name: register-of-injuries
title: Register of injuries
for_each: select id, code from sites order by code

sections.title: Injuries recorded at this workplace
sections.note: NSW Workplace Injury Management and Workers Compensation Act 1998 s 63 and the Victorian WIRC Act 2013 require a register at each workplace. Notifiable incidents are kept for at least 5 years (WHS Act s 38(7), HSWA s 57).
sections.sql: select ref, to_char(occurred_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as occurred, worker, role, location, nature, body_part, mechanism, reported_by, registered_on from v_register where site_id = $1 order by occurred_at

name: return-to-work-plan
title: Return to work plan
for_each: select id, ref from rtw_plans where status <> 'ended' order by ref

sections.title: Worker and claim
sections.sql: select p.ref as plan, c.worker, c.site, coalesce(c.claim_number, c.ref) as claim, c.nature, c.injured_on, c.rtw_coordinator from rtw_plans p join v_claims c on c.id = p.claim_id where p.id = $1

sections.title: The certificate this plan follows
sections.sql: select c.capacity, c.cert_hours as hours_a_week, c.cert_to as certificate_to, c.restrictions from rtw_plans p join v_claims c on c.id = p.claim_id where p.id = $1

sections.title: Duties, hours and review
sections.sql: select p.duties, p.hours_per_week, p.starts_on, p.review_on, p.status, p.agreed_on, p.agreed_by from rtw_plans p where p.id = $1

name: claim-summary
title: Claim summary
for_each: select id, ref from claims where status = 'open' order by ref

sections.title: Claim
sections.sql: select ref, coalesce(claim_number, '') as claim_number, worker, site, jurisdiction, injured_on, nature, body_part, liability, liability_on, case_manager, treating_doctor from v_claims where id = $1

sections.title: Certificates
sections.sql: select ref, from_on, to_on, capacity, hours_per_week, restrictions, doctor from certificates where claim_id = $1 order by from_on

sections.title: Deadlines
sections.sql: select item, due_on, standing, rule from v_deadlines where claim_id = $1 order by due_at

sections.title: Payments
sections.sql: select p.ref, p.kind, p.period_from, p.period_to, p.paid_on, p.payee, p.amount_cents, c.currency, p.reimbursed_on from payments p join v_claims c on c.id = p.claim_id where p.claim_id = $1 order by p.paid_on
